_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Days administrator alerts stay on the Notifications page before they are deleted.
examples: keep admin alerts for 90 days
delete notifications after a week
how long security alerts are kept

settings.description: Whether this security event raises an administrator alert on the Notifications page.
examples: stop alerting me about rate limits
notify the admin about failed logins
turn off sign-in block alerts

settings.description: How serious this security event's administrator alert is shown: info, warning or critical.
examples: make failed logins critical
show rate limit alerts as info
lower the alert level for blocked sign-ins

settings.description: How many times this security event must happen within its window before the administrator is alerted.
examples: alert after 10 failed logins
only notify after 50 rate limited requests
tell me about every blocked sign-in

settings.description: Length, in seconds, of the window in which this security event is counted toward its alert threshold.
examples: count failed logins over an hour
use a 5 minute window for rate limit alerts
count blocked sign-ins per day

settings.description: Days after which the last dependency scan counts as stale: the Dashboard card turns red and one administrator alert is raised.
examples: warn me if the vulnerability scan is more than 10 days old
dependency scan stale after two weeks
how old can the security scan get

settings.description: Hours without any recorded scanner run after which the dependency scan counts as stale (the scanner normally checks every 15 minutes).
examples: alert if the scanner has not run for 12 hours
the vulnerability scanner stopped
scanner heartbeat timeout

settings.description: Seconds between the app's reads of the dependency scan summary for administrator alerts.
examples: check the scan report every hour
read the vulnerability summary more often
how often the app looks at the dependency scan

excluded./channels/**: Delivery channels: only in_app exists; ntfy, email and twilio are not available yet.
excluded./events/host_approval/threshold: Host approval alerts are raised once per waiting host action; threshold does not apply.
excluded./events/host_approval/window_seconds: Host approval alerts are raised once per waiting host action; window does not apply.
excluded./events/supply_chain_fixable/threshold: Dependency scan alerts are raised once per new finding set or state change; threshold does not apply.
excluded./events/supply_chain_fixable/window_seco: Dependency scan alerts are raised once per new finding set or state change; window does not apply.
excluded./events/supply_chain_failed/threshold: Dependency scan alerts are raised once per new finding set or state change; threshold does not apply.
excluded./events/supply_chain_failed/window_secon: Dependency scan alerts are raised once per new finding set or state change; window does not apply.
excluded./events/supply_chain_stale/threshold: Dependency scan alerts are raised once per new finding set or state change; threshold does not apply.
excluded./events/supply_chain_stale/window_second: Dependency scan alerts are raised once per new finding set or state change; window does not apply.
